verdict.rationale: Clerky's document sets clearly involve multiple signers (collaborators, attorneys, co-founders) and a signing workflow (clerky-docs-13/17, clerky-docs-19/20), but this is signing within Clerky's own fixed legal document templates rather than a general-purpose 'send any document for signature with custom multi-recipient routing' capability. No evidence describes configurable signing order, roles, or routing logic for recipients. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of routing/sequencing controls, ability to send arbitrary documents (not just Clerky-generated ones) for signature, and independent confirmation of multi-recipient routing behavior.
